## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (unit; fixtures + golden files if a rule or parser changed)
- [ ] Any rule change cites an official source URL and retrieved date in `rules/rules.json`
- [ ] Docs updated (`npm run rules:doc` regenerated if rules changed; never hand-edited)
- [ ] TypeScript core and Swift CLI stay in parity (`npx tsx scripts/conformance.ts`)
- [ ] `./scripts/verify.sh` passes locally
- [ ] Nothing in `apps/web` or `packages/core` makes a network request
